eacc.name: effective accelerationists
eacc.ontology: Entropy is the enemy and growth is the only exit; feed the machine.
eacc.tldr: entropy is the enemy; feed the machine

progress.name: progress & abundance movement
progress.ontology: Scarcity is a policy choice; the bottleneck is permission, not physics. Build.
progress.tldr: the bottleneck is permission, not physics

hardtech.name: hard-tech & space frontier
hardtech.ontology: Civilization is downstream of physical capability — atoms over bits. Building real machines fast, at scale, in America is a moral project; multiplanetary life is the terminal goal.
hardtech.tldr: factories, rockets, defense — atoms over bits

rationalists.name: rationalists
rationalists.ontology: Reality is lawful and knowable through Bayesian updating; beliefs should pay rent in anticipated experience, and most catastrophes are epistemic failures first.

doomers.name: AI-safety doomers
doomers.ontology: We are building minds we can't steer, on a timeline set by a race nobody can exit.
doomers.tldr: minds we can't steer, on a race nobody can exit

ea.name: effective altruists
ea.ontology: All sentient welfare counts equally across space and time; the real currency is counterfactual impact, measured and maximized under moral uncertainty.

tpot.name: tpot / post-rationalists
tpot.ontology: Rationality was a phase; wisdom might not be. Bodies, meaning, sincerity wearing irony as a coat.
tpot.tldr: rationality was a phase; wisdom might not be

nondual.name: consciousness & psychedelic twitter
nondual.ontology: The mystery is real, measurable, and schedulable. The clinical trial as pilgrimage route.
nondual.tldr: the mystery is real, measurable, schedulable

btc.name: bitcoin maxis
btc.ontology: Sound money is the base layer of civilization and a moral imperative; Bitcoin is the only credibly neutral monetary substrate — everything else is fiat, noise, or a scam.
btc.tldr: bitcoin is the only sound money

eth.name: ethereum builders
eth.ontology: Reality is programmable coordination; credibly neutral protocols are how humanity scales trust. Progress is real but must be steered — d/acc over both doom and recklessness.

defi.name: DeFi & stablecoin builders
defi.ontology: Finance is being rebuilt as open programmable infrastructure; stablecoins are the internet's money layer and regulation is the moat, not the enemy.

degens.name: degens & memecoin culture
degens.ontology: Attention is the only real asset and price is the only truth; everything is musical chairs and the sin is not playing but exiting late. Nihilism worn as comedy.
degens.tldr: everything is a casino; ape accordingly

regens.name: regens & solarpunks
regens.ontology: The future is green, built, and beautiful — collapse is a failure of imagination. Degrowth's optimistic cousin across the water.
regens.tldr: the future is green, built, and beautiful

degrowth.name: degrowthers & climate realists
degrowth.ontology: Infinite growth on a finite planet is the cancer cell's ontology; live well within limits.

longevity.name: longevity & biohackers
longevity.ontology: Death is a technical problem with a research budget. Don't die until you can't die.
longevity.tldr: don't die until you can't die

maha.name: MAHA & health freedom
maha.ontology: Heal the body first — the food, the medicine, the light — and the body politic follows.
maha.tldr: heal the body; the body politic follows

nrx.name: neoreaction & the new right
nrx.ontology: Democracy is a failed god; competence is monarchical. Retire the regime, run the state like a firm.
nrx.tldr: democracy is a failed god; competence is monarchical

netstate.name: network-state builders
netstate.ontology: Don't fix the country — fork it. Citizenship as a subscription, governance as a product.
netstate.tldr: don't fix the country — fork it

indie.name: indie hackers
indie.ontology: Leverage is now individually held — one person plus models can occupy niches that needed a company. Revenue is the only real validation; institutions are optional overhead.
indie.tldr: one person + AI = a whole company

maga.name: maga / populist right
maga.tldr: the nation is a home, betrayed by its managers
maga.ontology: The nation is a home, not an economic zone — and the home was betrayed by its own managers.

progleft.name: progressive left
progleft.tldr: power hides in language, defaults, institutions
progleft.ontology: Power hides in language, defaults, and institutions; listen from the margins to see it.

establishment.name: liberal establishment
establishment.tldr: institutions and expertise hold it together
establishment.ontology: Liberal democracy works through institutions, expertise, and procedure. The job is competent governance and defending norms against extremes on both sides.

finance.name: wall street / macro
finance.tldr: markets price everything; don't fight the Fed
finance.ontology: Prices aggregate all information and capital flows are the real politics. Everything else is narrative wrapped around the number.

christian.name: christian twitter
christian.tldr: moral order is given, not invented
christian.ontology: Reality is created and moral order is given; scripture and the church outrank secular consensus. History is a spiritual drama whose stakes exceed politics.

stan.name: stan / pop culture
stan.ontology: Devotion is coordination: the most disciplined armies on the platform worship a bias, not a politics — and every tribe on this map envies their logistics.

sports.name: sports twitter
sports.tldr: loyalty, stats, and the eternal debate
sports.ontology: Merit is settled on the field and argued forever after. Loyalty is inherited, stats are scripture, and the debate itself is the point.

georgists.name: georgists
georgists.ontology: Land value is created by the community, so land rent belongs to everyone; most economic dysfunction — housing above all — traces to private capture of that rent.

girardians.name: girardians
girardians.tldr: desire is mimetic; scapegoats keep the peace
girardians.ontology: Humans want what others want; rivalry escalates until it discharges onto a scapegoat. Culture, religion, and markets are machines for managing mimetic conflict.

landian.name: landian accel
landian.ontology: Modernity is capital using humans to bootstrap its own substrate; acceleration isn't a policy choice, it's what is already happening. The horror reading of e/acc's optimism.

metamodern.name: metamodernists
metamodern.tldr: integrate irony and sincerity; develop in stages
metamodern.ontology: Culture and persons develop through stages that must be integrated, not skipped; the modern/postmodern fight resolves by holding both at once.

forecasters.name: forecasters
forecasters.tldr: put a number on it or it's vibes
forecasters.ontology: Beliefs are bets and calibration is virtue. Prediction markets and scoring rules extract honest probabilities from talk.

cryonics.name: cryonicists
cryonics.tldr: death is information loss; preserve the pattern
cryonics.ontology: Death is the loss of information, not an event; preserve the brain's pattern and future medicine can restart it. The original transhumanism.

pronatalists.name: pronatalists
pronatalists.tldr: the birth rate is the deepest metric; have the kids
pronatalists.ontology: Civilization's deepest metric is the birth rate, and it's falling everywhere at once. Have the kids.

doomeroptimists.name: doomer optimists
doomeroptimists.tldr: collapse is coming; build local lifeboats
doomeroptimists.ontology: Industrial civilization is overshooting hard biophysical limits — but the answer is skills, land, and community, not despair. Prep by rebuilding the local.

remilia.name: remilia / net spirituality
remilia.tldr: the timeline is a spiritual plane
remilia.ontology: Identity dissolves into the network; anonymous posting, aesthetics, and memetic play are devotional acts. The milady cult of the feed.

cozyweb.name: cozyweb
cozyweb.tldr: small quiet internet over the big feed
cozyweb.ontology: The good internet is small, slow, and tended — group chats, blogs, digital gardens. Scale is the disease; context is the cure.

tradcaths.name: trad catholics
tradcaths.ontology: Modernity took a wrong turn at liberalism; truth lives in tradition, hierarchy, and the old Mass. Liturgy as resistance.

wsb.name: wallstreetbets
wsb.tldr: the market is a casino; ape together strong
wsb.ontology: The market is a casino where the little guy can gang up on the house. Conviction, leverage, and memes over analysis; loss porn is content.

astrology.name: astrology twitter
astrology.ontology: Celestial patterns index temperament and timing; the chart is a symbolic language for fate and self-knowledge, held with varying degrees of irony.

ufo.name: ufo / disclosure
ufo.tldr: the veil is thinner every hearing
ufo.ontology: We are not alone, the government knows, and the veil is thinner every hearing.

ocean.name: the neoliberalism ocean
ocean.tldr: the default every tribe defines itself against
ocean.ontology: Mainstream liberalism — not an island but the water: markets as nature, procedure as faith, the default every tribe defines itself against. It doesn't feel like an ideology for the same reason water doesn't feel wet.

islam.name: the islamic revival
islam.tldr: the ummah online; submission as freedom
islam.ontology: A fifth of humanity in one ummah: submission as freedom, the feed as minbar. The largest coherent ontology the discourse map forgets.

china.name: the chinese techno-civilization
china.tldr: the state as a five-thousand-year project
china.ontology: The state as a five-thousand-year project; harmony over discourse, capacity over process. Barely on X — enormous on earth.

catholic.name: catholicism proper
catholic.tldr: a billion members, one pope, time in centuries
catholic.ontology: Beneath the tradcath vanguard, the two-thousand-year ship itself: a billion members, one pope, time measured in centuries.

india.name: civilizational india
india.tldr: a civilization reawakening, not a country
india.ontology: Not a country — a civilization reawakening after a thousand-year interruption. The diaspora fights its wars in english.

pentecostal.name: global pentecostalism
pentecostal.tldr: the spirit descends in lagos, são paulo, seoul
pentecostal.ontology: The fastest-growing religion on earth: the spirit descends in Lagos, São Paulo, Seoul — and the feed never notices.

indigenous.name: the indigenous resurgence
indigenous.tldr: the land is a relative, not a resource
indigenous.ontology: The land is not a resource but a relative, and it is taking its names back. The oldest ontology on the map, newly load-bearing.

manifestation.name: the manifestation web
manifestation.tldr: align the inner state; the outer follows
manifestation.ontology: Reality is a mirror: align the inner state and the outer world follows. The largest folk religion online, and it doesn't know it's one.

conspiracy.name: the conspiracist omniverse
conspiracy.tldr: nothing is as it seems, on purpose
conspiracy.ontology: Nothing is as it seems, and someone meant it that way. Every institution's collapse in trust washes up here as new territory.

hustle.name: hustle world
hustle.tldr: the job is a scam; the way out is volume
hustle.ontology: The job is a scam and the way out is volume: content, flips, funnels, reps. YouTube's biggest religion.

manosphere.name: the manosphere
manosphere.tldr: rebuild the man; the world follows
manosphere.ontology: The crisis is male — purpose, testosterone, marriage, meaning. Rebuild the man and the world follows.

witchtok.name: witchtok & the old ways
witchtok.tldr: ritual, tarot, the moon as calendar
witchtok.ontology: The disenchanted world re-enchants from below: ritual, tarot, the moon as calendar. The gods that were here before the feed.

socialist.name: the socialist left
socialist.tldr: the oldest war is labor versus capital
socialist.ontology: The oldest war is labor versus capital; everything else is noise over that signal.

postliberal.name: the post-liberals
postliberal.tldr: rebuild on faith, family, common good
postliberal.ontology: Liberalism ate its own foundations; rebuild on faith, family, and the common good.

refusal.name: tech refusal
refusal.tldr: the only winning move is to log off
refusal.ontology: The machine's product is your attention, and the only winning move is to log off. The decelerate coast's far shore.

dacc.name: d/acc
dacc.ontology: Accelerate the defensive things — crypto, bio-defense, open source — so the power lands in everyone's hands.

liminal.name: the liminal web
liminal.tldr: hold the whole; don't pick a jersey
liminal.ontology: The crisis under the crises is sensemaking itself; hold the whole, don't pick a jersey.

nihilists.name: the nihilist trench
nihilists.ontology: Nothing means anything and nothing is worth wanting — the undertow beneath every other territory. Named here as a hazard to navigation, not steelmanned, by design.
